messages.subject: Tomorrow: Formatting R plots for publication
parts:
Hi all,

Tomorrow at D-RUG Rosemary Hartman will make a presentation on that perennial pain - formatting your plots for publication.  From Rosie:

I will give a brief overview of how to use ggplot themes and Inkscape to format R plots for publication. It is designed to be an introduction to the topic (I am certainly no expert but have picked up a few tricks) for beginners. If anyone has more tricks they would like to share, we can all share ideas.

Usual place and time: Wickson 2124, 1-3PM

Best,

Noam
